supplemental_items.interpretation: Bounds are against the full main array, not the visible slice; both First and Break are integer-converted before bounds checks. An exactly non-null crossed record is indexed for main/exact stop separately; no shape fallback. Confirmation uses physical Order direction and default intrabar-start. Stop price is a string even when stop times are suppressed by horizon. Only a non-null identity performs the audit lookup, but the physical formatter is always invoked, including with null. No formation-Order reconstruction or alternate-key search.
supplemental_items.conditional_boundary: No empirical runtime or cross-owner acceptance asserted.
